name: Power Cash Rewards

apr.notes: 17.99% variable APR for purchases. 0% introductory APR for 12 months on balance transfers made in first 60 days. 3% balance transfer fee per transaction.

credit_required.notes: Credit score of 700+ generally recommended; PenFed membership required.

base_rate.description: 1.5% cash back on all purchases; 2% for PenFed Honors Advantage Members

rewards.redemption_notes: Unlimited cash back with no caps or restrictions. Cash back never expires for as long as you keep the card. Redeem as statement credit, deposit into PenFed checking or savings, or transfer to another institution. 2% rate for Honors Advantage Members (military or Access America/Free Checking account holders).

signup_bonus.description: $100 statement credit after spending $1,500 within the first 90 days of account opening.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Protect your cell phone against theft and damage by paying your monthly wireless bill with your PenFed credit card.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Coverage
benefits.description: When you purchase your travel ticket with your PenFed credit card, eligible for accident coverage of up to $250,000.

benefits.title: Complimentary Concierge Service
benefits.description: Visa concierge service available 24/7, 365 days a year.

benefits.title: Access to Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.description: Access to premium offers and discounts on luxury hotels around the world.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Use your PenFed credit card worldwide without any additional fees.

notes: Visa Signature. $0 annual fee. 1.5% flat cash back (2% for Honors Advantage Members). No foreign transaction fees.
